employee-local-stdio.description: Local stdio Employee FastMCP (same process machine)

employee-remote-http.description: Remote-style HTTP MCP — start: uv run python -m deepsupport_os.mcp.servers.employee --http

notes: In-process LangChain mock tools remain the default (MCP_LOCAL_TOOLS=true).
Enable remote servers here and set MCP_REMOTE_ENABLED=true to merge remote tools into the agent.
Add public/third-party MCP by appending a server block with url + transport (sse|streamable_http|http).
